children: Pranav Mukul New Delhi: Home services platform Urban Company has appointed Morgan Stanley to manage its 2,500 crore qualified institutional placement and begun roadshows for the fundraising, meeting potential investors, according to people familiar with the matter.

A significant portion of the proceeds is expected to go towards InstaHelp, its instant house help business, which has been incurring heavy losses as the company invests in expanding the segment, one of the persons said. However, brokerages have assigned little to no value to the business, citing concerns over sustained losses and the challenge of achieving profitability targets. In an investor presentation earlier this month, Urban Company said InstaHelp was driving customer frequency and attracting new users to the platform. The firm said absolute losses in the segment would remain elevated over the next few quarters as it invests to consolidate its market leadership.

title: Urban Co Taps Morgan Stanley for 2.5kcr QIP
